text:
Priya: Heads up — spotted a phantom vendor credit in NetSuite for ACCT-298 after tonight's pricing experiment. Not present in Stripe. Looks automated, not manual.
Ashley: Link + IDs? can you drop the NS link and the Stripe invoice id so we can cross-ref quickly
Priya: NetSuite link: https://ns.example.com/app/accounting/transactions/invoice.nl?id=987654321
Priya: Stripe invoice lookup: `stripe invoices retrieve inv_3K7x...` — Stripe shows no credit. NetSuite invoice has a negative line with memo 'promo-PE42' and external_id 'stripe_inv_inv_3K7x...:PE-42'
Dan: Checked webhook-proxy logs around 2026-03-22T23:12Z. NetSuite responded 409 on create with body: ```{"error":"external_id conflict","existing_external_id":"stripe_inv_inv_3K7x..."}``` then our retry path created a separate invoice because we appended the experiment suffix to external_id. That dup then flowed to the mapper which produced a credit memo.
Priya: So appending the experiment id broke idempotency and caused a duplicate that ended up as a credit memo?
Dan: Exactly. For the experiment we added `:PE-42` to external_id to avoid overwriting, but NetSuite dedupe uses the canonical external_id. Our retry logic treated the 409 as a create failure and created a new record with modified external_id, which downstream mapping interpreted as adjustment/credit.
billing-bot: dlq-processor attempted retry for job 7821 -> failed (409) [logs id 44f7] :warning:
Ashley: Impact numbers? how many customers / total $ impact
Priya: Quick tally: 7 invoices across 3 customers. Total credits ~ $1,250. Two mid-value accounts (ACCT-298 $620, ACCT-441 $300) need manual review first.
Dan: Proposed fix plan:
1) Quick normalization: ns-sync should strip `:PE-*` suffix from external_id before calling NetSuite (5-10m hotfix).
2) Migration script: identify NetSuite records with external_id containing `:PE-` and map duplicates back to originals, void or merge the phantom credit memos (NetSuite admin required).
3) Long term: change idempotency to use canonical plan code and add tests to prevent experiment suffixes.
NetSuite-admin: I can perform the voids but need Finance approval for >$500 voids. Also will need the service account SOAP creds rotated if we run the migration script.
Ashley: @priya can you confirm finance approval for the two larger voids so I can open the NS change ticket and schedule maintenance?
Priya: Approve voids for ACCT-298 ($620) and ACCT-441 ($300). For the remaining smaller ones, run the migration to reprocess. Please do NOT bulk reprocess until ns-sync normalization is deployed.
Dan: I'll open a hotfix PR now for normalization and cut a deploy. After deploy I'll requeue the DLQ job. Requeue command (ops):
```
curl -X POST https://ops.example.com/dlq/requeue -H "Authorization: Bearer $OPS_TOKEN" -d 'job=7821'
```
Dan: I'll coordinate with Ashley so the migration runs once NS is safe.
Ashley: Can we add a saved search in NetSuite to alert on external_id containing `:PE-` so Finance can monitor? I can add that and give Priya access.
Priya: Yes please — add the saved search and also a quick column in our billing report to flag records with `:PE-`.
Dan: Owners: Dan (code + run requeue), Ashley (NS admin + voids and saved search), Priya (finance approval + ticket). Target: normalization deployed within 1hr; migration and voids within 24h.
billing-bot: deploy:hotfix/ns-sync-normalize pushed by dan at 2234567300, CI green :rocket:
Ashley: I'll open NS change request and tentatively block 02:00-03:00 UTC for manual work if needed.
Priya: Created FIN-3421 with the details and assignees (Dan/Ashley). Will update when voids complete.
Dan: 👍
Ashley: 🤝
Priya: ✅
